The computer program was written to calculate the 
modal frequencies, flow excitation ranges, and flow-induced 
stresses for the longitudinal modes and the convolute bending 
mode in a metal bellows. This program is written to apply to

acoustic mode frequency and velocity. This program, however, 
does not conduct flow-induced vibration analysis for a 
flexhose and does not calculate static stresses in a bellows. . 
The flexhose and static stress analysis have to be done by 
hand. 
This computer program takes into account the 
uncertainty factors and acoustic factor for flow-induced 
stress. The output values for flow-induced stress have the 
appropriate uncertainty factors and acoustic factor already 
applied.
